name: code-audit-collect
description: Spawns 4 independent analyst agents, waits for all to finish, then pipes their collected results into a synthesizer via /collect

config.task: Scan all src/ directories. Find exports nothing imports, functions never called, config options read but never set, event listeners registered but never triggered, type definitions with zero usage. Trace imports with read_file and list_directory. Report ONLY confirmed dead symbols: file:line | symbol | reason. Skip tests and node_modules.

Find logic bugs in this project: missing awaits, race conditions on shared mutable state, off-by-one errors, unguarded null access, Map.get without nullish handling, event listener leaks, unclosed resources. Report: file:line, 3-5 line snippet, what breaks, the fix.

Find performance problems: O(n^2) loops, repeated computation in hot paths, string concat in loops, full rebuilds where partial updates work, sync I/O on hot paths, regex in loops. Report: file:line, code, estimated cost, the fix.

Find interface mismatches: Map key format differences (with/without # prefix), type assertions masking errors, events emitted but never listened to, config name mismatches between set/read, function signatures disagreeing with callers. Report file:line for BOTH sides.

You will receive the combined output from 4 code audit agents. Deduplicate, remove speculation, keep only confirmed issues. Rank by severity: data-loss > logic bugs > perf > dead code > inconsistencies. Output numbered list, max 25 items. Each: severity, file:line, 5-line snippet, what breaks, fix as code.

config.message: Collect-style audit complete — see #synthesizer for results
